meta.description: Jayi ke tazevaredha dar gerdehamayiha va konvansionhaye furry dustane taze peyda mikonand. Az Global Furry Television.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: Yek website-e rasmi-ye Global Furry Television
official.domain-heading: Saythaye rasmi-ye GFTV ba globalfurry.tv ya gftv.asia tamam mishavand
official.domain-body: Neshani ra az enteha bekhanid, az akharin noghte pish az avalin slash-e taki. Sayti ke be chiz-e digari khatm shavad GFTV nist, hatta agar in nam jayi zudtar dar neshani amade bashad.
official.secure-heading: Saythaye amn az HTTPS estefade mikonand
official.secure-body: Donbal-e namad-e ghofl begardid, ya https:// dar ebteda-ye neshani. Ettela'at-e shakhsi-ye khod ra faghat dar yek sayt-e rasmi va ba ettesal-e amn be eshterak begozarid.
update.label: Beruzresani
update.ready: Noskhe-ye tazei az GFTV HelloSpot amade ast.
hero.card-alt: Kart-e nam-e HelloSpot. Ruye an Hello va 哈喽 kenar-e yek labkhand-e bozorg neveshte shode, ruye navarhaye rangin-kamani-ye GFTV.
hero.title: Yek HelloSpot peyda kardid!
hero.lede: Dar gerdehamayiha va konvansionhaye furry, yek HelloSpot jayi ast ke tazevaredha dustane taze peyda mikonand.
how.title: HelloSpot chetor kar mikonad
how.spot.title: Labkhand ra peyda konid
how.spot.body: Donbal-e HelloSmile ruye yek kart, band-e gardan ya tablo begardid. Har ja bashad, hamanja yek HelloSpot ast.
how.hello.title: Salam konid
how.hello.body: Biayid va salam konid. Dar HelloSpot hichkas entezar nadarad ke az ghabl kasi ra beshenasid.
how.friend.title: Dust peyda konid
how.friend.body: Ba adamhaye atrafetan ashna shavid, va ba kasi beravid ke dar gerdehamayi-ye ba'di donbalash begardid.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) bozorgtarin kanal-e khabari-ye jame'e-ye furry dar Asiast, mostaghar dar Sangapur.
about.body-2: Ma roshd-e jame'e-ye furry ra neshan midahim ta hame, emruz va farda, ghadrash ra bedanand, va fazahayi faraham mikonim ta mardom ba yekdigar ashna shavand va hamdigar ra befahmand.
about.body-3: Tim-e GFTV az khane ta gharehaye bozorg gostarde ast; timi beynolmelali, chandfarhangi va chandzabane.
